LESSON: POSITION AND DIRECTION

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade three
Subject: MATHEMATICAL ACTIVITIES
Strand: Geometry
Topic 3.1: Position and Direction
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 5

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Position and Direction, part of Geometry in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade three MATHEMATICAL ACTIVITIES.

Key inquiry question: What is the importance of directions in real life situations?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. move along a straight line from a point,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Position and Direction in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

B. identify the right and left side from a point,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Position and Direction in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

C. turn to the right from a point,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Position and Direction in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Position and Direction together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Digital literacy: learner uses digital devices to play games involving movement on straight lines, to the right and left.

● Collaboration: learner teams up with others to move along a straight line from a given point outside the classroom.

Values:
● Unity: learner plays games involving moving along a straight line then turning left or right peers.

● Respect: learner takes turn in activities as they move straight outside the classroom then turn to the left.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

● Positive discipline: learner follows laid down procedures to carry out activities as they move along a straight line from a

given point outside the classroom.

● Social cohesion: learner gives others equal opportunities in sharing responsibilities as they play games.

Link to other learning areas:

The learner is able to relate the concept of position and direction to the concept of location in Environmental Activities.
